reason: Path traversal in optimized-deps .map handling (GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9) — a `vite dev`-server-only request-handling bug. This pipeline never runs `vite dev`; CI only runs `vite build` and `vite preview` against a build already produced from trusted source, and the fix requires a Vite 6+ major bump not yet scheduled.

server.fs.deny bypass on Windows alternate data streams (GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff) — dev-server-only, Windows-only; same reasoning as 1120784.
